items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 19:1
items.html: The Land of Israel is the discernment of Yetzirah in this world. For this world is divided according to its value into BYA: the place of the Temple is the discernment of the Beriah of this world, the Land of Israel is the discernment of the Yetzirah of this world, and outside the Land is the discernment of the Assiyah of this world. (Item 49).
